info.title: Meridian API
info.description: Multi-tenant work and knowledge API. The tenant is always resolved from the session, never from the request.

204.description: Password changed; every other sign-in ended

400.description: Current password wrong, or new password too weak/unchanged

202.description: If the address belongs to an account, a reset email is on its way

401.description: Refresh token invalid, expired or reused

400.description: Invalid or expired token, or weak password

404.description: Project not found or not visible
Project not found or not visible

204.description: Grant stored (replaces any earlier grant for the same subject)

404.description: Project not found or not visible

200.description: Your active sign-ins in this workspace

404.description: No such active session of yours

token.description: Empty in cookie mode (the session lives in an HttpOnly cookie).

visibility.description: `workspace` (everyone in the workspace) or `private` (explicit grants only).

refresh_token.description: API clients send the refresh token here; browsers rely on the HttpOnly cookie.
